The '''Korvaii system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Kordu sector/Legends|Kordu sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korvaii]].
